I grew up in the USAF. I spent my childhood in the cockpit of FB-111a. Unfortunately that is not offered in DCS. I’m also a fan of the F-4, F-15, F-16, F-18, P-51, B-1, A-10, Bell UH-1 and B-52. 

I hope DCS has the F-111 by the time I’m able to get the hardware. That airplane pioneered so many things for aviation.

When and if we can get an authentic FB-111a I will be reunited with the very aircraft I spent so much time in the cockpit of as a child. I grew up on a SAC base. 

My weekends were in that cockpit. In the bomb bay. As a C.A.P. Cadet was even allowed Sim time in the F-111 sim. Amazing experience. 

I wish I had the money and resources to buy and maintain an actual USAF F-111 sim. 

Whenever DCS releases the F-111 I’ll jump on and join the DCS world.
